Pokemon Abyss Eye (M5) Sealed Japanese Booster Box

  • Authentic Japanese print
  • Factory sealed

How to spot a fake

  • Inside, every pack has crisp, even crimps and the same set code. Glossy, off-colour or mismatched packs are not factory.
  • "No Outer Shrink" boxes won't have the printed wrap — the packs are what to check.
  • Anything look off? Send us a photo before opening and we'll sort it.

Returns accepted within 7 days of delivery if the item is not as described. Sealed and international orders are final sale. This doesn't limit your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.
